name: What are the typical costs associated with selling a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with selling a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selling a rental property, typical costs include real estate commissions, closing costs, title insurance, and potential repairs or staging expenses. A practical tradeoff is balancing the investment in minor repairs or staging against the potential for a higher sale price. Kelby Contreras will provide a transparent breakdown of estimated selling costs for your property, helping you understand the net proceeds and make informed decisions during the sales process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs typically include commissions, closing costs, and title insurance. We provide a transparent breakdown to help you understand net proceeds.
